common.offline: You no get network. Na the last thing wey we see dey show.
common.error: Something don spoil. Abeg try again.

trust.message: Your money dey safe. Supplier go only collect pay after goods don reach. If people no join reach target, we go return all your money back by itself.

home.title: Buy together. Pay when goods reach.
home.tagline: Join traders for your market buy goods for bulk for wholesale price.
home.explore: See group buys wey dey open
home.noPools: You never join any group buy yet.

onboarding.title: Create your account
onboarding.phoneHelp: We go send 6-digit code give you by SMS.
onboarding.walletBody: We go create secure wallet for this phone. Na only you fit approve payment, with your fingerprint, face or PIN.
onboarding.backupBody: If you lose this phone, you go need this backup to collect your money. Write am down and keep am private.
onboarding.testMoneyBody: This na test version. We go add practice money make you fit try payment.

explore.title: Group buys wey dey open
explore.empty: No group buy dey open now. Come back soon.

pool.organizer: Trader for your market organize am
pool.indicative: Naira amount na estimate. You go pay the price wey dey now; if the group reach better price, dem go return the difference give you by itself.
pool.paying: We dey confirm with your phone…
pool.confirmBody: Press confirm to approve. Your money go stay for escrow till goods reach.
pool.joined: You don join! We go tell you when price drop.
pool.ifFails: If e no fill or supplier no deliver, dem go refund you by itself.
pool.rights: If anything wrong with the goods, you fit report problem within 48 hours after delivery.
pool.shareText: Join our group buy: {product}. Price now na {price} per unit. {link}
pool.pickupReady: Your goods don ready: come collect {count} units.

stateNote.Expired: People no reach. Dem dey refund everybody full.
stateNote.Failed: The order no work. Dem go refund everybody full.
stateNote.Cancelled: Dem cancel this group buy. Dem go refund everybody full.

pool.pickupReadyShort: Your goods don ready. Organizer go tell you how many units you go collect.
pool.nextBreakShort: {count} more units and price go drop

organize.title: Organize group buy
organize.intro: Pick offer, set deadline and pickup place. Share the link with traders for your market.
organize.notOrganizer: You never be organizer yet. Ask support make dem approve you.
organize.feeHelp: Optional, up to 1%. Members go see am before dem pay.

delivery.title: Confirm delivery
delivery.intro: Count the goods when dem reach and take photo. Na this one go pay supplier.
delivery.short: {count} units no reach. Dem go refund members for the missing goods.

organize.activateHelp: Do this one time after support approve you.

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupWarn: Anybody wey get this one fit carry your money. No share am.
settings.passkeyHelp: Next time, use your fingerprint, face or PIN enter instead of SMS code.
settings.passkeyDone: Passkey don add. You fit use am enter.

generic.todo: Abeg try again. If e continue, talk to support.

network.what: We no fit reach the server.
network.todo: Check your network and try again.

declined.todo: Dem no collect anything. Try again when you ready.

OTP_WRONG.todo: Check the SMS and try again.

OTP_RATE_LIMITED.what: Too many code you don request.
OTP_RATE_LIMITED.todo: Wait small minutes and try again.

FEE_TOO_HIGH.what: This payment need more fee pass wetin we fit cover.

unsafe.what: This request no look correct, so we stop am.
unsafe.todo: Dem no collect anything. Try again, and talk to support if e continue.

IMAGE_INVALID.what: We no fit read that photo.
IMAGE_INVALID.todo: Take the photo again or choose another one.

supplier.title: Supplier portal
supplier.applyIntro: Tell us about your business. We dey verify every supplier before offers go live.
supplier.categories: Wetin you dey sell (like rice, beans, oil)

supplier.rejected: Dem no approve your application. Talk to support.
supplier.activateHelp: Do this one time after we approve you.

dispute.sent: Dem don send your report. Arbiter go decide within 5 days.

offers.takenDown: Dem don take am down (new pools only)
